name: NinjaOne agent reset
installerCheck: SHA256 above, then Authenticode signature Valid with signer O=NinjaOne LLC. Versioned generic agent MSI (no token inside; the public generic-installer link redirects here). The agent updates itself after install.
packageArguments: Optional. {"Apply":"true"} (base64 eyJBcHBseSI6InRydWUifQ==) removes the old agent and installs the pinned one. Without Apply the run is read-only. The location token comes from the environment variable RELIAN_NINJA_TOKENID, never from the arguments.
